title: Exercise 3.2 · Q12
summary: In a secondary school with 125 students participate in at least one of the following sports: cricket,…
alt: Exercise 3.2 · Q12: In a secondary school with 125 students participate in at least one of the following sports: cricket, football, or hockey.; 60 students play cricket.; 70 students play football.; 40 students play hockey.; 25 students play both cricket and football.; 15 students play both football and hockey.; 10 students play both cricket and hockey. (a) How many students play all three sports? (b) Draw a Venn diagram showing the distribution of sports participation in all the games.

steps.title: Set up
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{Let }C=\text{ cricket, }F=\text{ football, }H=\\[5pt]&\quad \text{hockey}\\[5pt]&\text{n(C }\cup F\cup \text{ H) }=125\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(every student plays at least one sport)}\end{aligned}\]

steps.title: Part (a)
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{(a) n(C }\cup F\cup \text{ H) }=\text{ n(C) }+\text{ n(F) }+\text{ n(H)}\\[5pt]&\quad -\text{ n(C }\cap \text{ F) }-\text{ n(F }\cap \text{ H) }-\text{ n(C }\cap \text{ H) }+\\[5pt]&\quad \text{n(C }\cap F\cap \text{ H)}\\[5pt]&\quad 125=60+70+40-25-15-10+x\\[5pt]&\quad 125=170-50+x\\[5pt]&\quad 125=120+x\\[5pt]&\quad \therefore x=5,\text{ so }\textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{5}}\text{ students play all}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{three sports.}\end{aligned}\]

steps.title: Part (b)
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{(b) Region values for the Venn}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{diagram:}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Only cricket }=60-25-10+5=30\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Only football }=70-25-15+5=35\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Only hockey }=40-15-10+5=20\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Cricket and football only }=25-5=\\[5pt]&\quad 20\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Football and hockey only }=15-5=10\end{aligned}\]

steps.title: Result
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\quad \text{Cricket and hockey only }=10-5=5\\[5pt]&\quad \text{All three }=5\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Outside all circles }=0\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(everyone plays at least one sport)}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Check: }30+35+20+20+10+5+5\\[5pt]&\quad =125\text{ $\;\checkmark$}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Draw three overlapping circles C, F, H}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{inside U and write these seven numbers}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{in the regions }(0\text{ outside).}\end{aligned}\]
